methodology: Seven (by default) alternating before/after fresh-process runs per case, after calibration and one warmup per build. Each process reads a common batch of identical graph records in -tf mode. Wall time includes startup, parsing, analysis, cleanup and CSV output. Per-graph time is elapsed/batch size. Calibration targets the faster build for at least target_seconds, capped by max_batch and a slow-build batch budget; those bounds can leave short samples. Comparison is ratio of medians, not maximum speedup. Every output is checked byte-for-byte and each case against the independent reference. No performance claim is made about unmeasured graph families or machines.
post_measurement_runner_change: After the successful measured run, initialize completed=false before the reference/calibration steps so a failed rerun cannot leave an old report marked complete. Also reuse that initialization timestamp in the report. Timing, batching, comparison, and statistic calculations are unchanged. runner_sha256 identifies the actually executed version; final_runner_sha256 identifies the committed checkpoint fix.
